notes: Single source of truth for the world frame. Source coordinates are ME-GIS metres (flat grid, y north). World units: 1 unit = 1 km; origin at frame centre; X east, -Z north, Y up.

source.crs: ME-GIS flat metric grid (tagged EPSG:32631, never reprojected)

vertical.notes: Terrain height in world units = exaggeration * H * (h/H)^gamma with h = (DEM metres - seaLevelMetres)/1000 and H = referenceKm. The ME-DEM datum puts sea level at 16 grey levels (304.8 m): DEM values below it are real shelf bathymetry; seas are below-datum regions connected to coast.seaSeedsKm. Relief is split by scale (vertical v2): a Gaussian low-pass (macroSigmaKm) keeps the full exaggeration so ranges tower, the meso band between macroSigmaKm and mesoSigmaKm is scaled by detailRatio, and the micro band below mesoSigmaKm by microRatio, so ranges read as massive eroded bodies instead of needle fields while peaks stay recognisable. Inside a Gaussian band around every canon river (valleyBandKm) the split relief is pulled back down to the unsplit exaggeration where the low-pass lifted it (narrow valley floors next to ranges), never raised.

demCalibration.notes: Arda 32k UInt16 -> ME-DEM 8-bit grey (19.05 m per grey level). Measured table from data/source/arda/docs/2026-09-20-32k-dem.md; top point extrapolated.

rivers.notes: Exaggerated channel widths (km) for readability at diorama scale. Bake v2: every canon line gets a processed centreline (smoothKm corner smoothing, sampleKm spacing); lines joined end-to-start form one stem with a monotone water level (profile.*: asymmetric isotonic fit to thalweg + depth[class] - filling costs fillWeight x cutting; a sill is cut at most maxCut deep unless that would hold back a pool deeper than maxPool; maxCutOverrides for gorges; smoothKmByClass; free sources in a hollow below a sill within trimSourceKm start at the sill). falls are the only places the surface may drop steeply. sinks = endorheic lakes (bake lake keys). bankKm / bankSlope (by class) ease valley walls beside the channel to at most that slope; bankOverrides keep steeper walls in declared gorges.

flowWidth.notes: per-line width = widthKm[class] x clamp((upstream network length / refKm[class])^exponent, min, max); streams keep their class width

bankOverrides.name: Emyn Muil gorges (Argonath, Nen Hithoel, Rauros)

tableScale.notes: Lens/DOF physics treat the diorama as a physical model: 1 km of world = 1 mm of table (1:1,000,000).

coast.notes: Sea seeds (ME-GIS km) for the coastline flood fill: west ocean, Bay of Belfalas, south coast, Ice Bay of Forochel (joins the ocean only north of the frame).

lakes.notes: Lake levels (keys = bake lake keys, as in lakes.json): levels{} authored override; else the outlet river's natural start level capped by the shorePercentile of the shore ring (a lake spilling over falls right at its outlet, and lakes without an outlet, use the percentile). Beds are deepened below the level; shores above it are graded down to level + shoreEpsilon over gradeKm (default 0.3*sqrt(area), 1.5-5 km), low shores rise to it.
